name: scan-time-preflight
body: The scan driver's preflight: before spawning a language's frontend, verify the language's scan-time tools are resolvable on PATH and fail with an actionable error naming the missing tool. The preflight logic is `rust.apg.scan_time_preflight` (real in the branch graph, `src/main.rs:1024-1037`; covered by `rust.apg.tests.e2e.scan_time_preflight_reports_missing_tool`), invoked from the frontend spawn path (`rust.apg.spawn_frontend`), which assembles the command and calls `Command::spawn`. `available_languages` already probes installed frontend artifacts, which is a different question — artifact present, not toolchain present — and its silent-skip behaviour for a missing artifact is out of scope; `frontend_cmd` and `should_spawn_language` are consulted but not modified. Both `rust.apg.scan_time_preflight` and `rust.apg.spawn_frontend` are real, resolving `implemented-by` targets of this component — no planned node is involved.
